No API, GPU, candidate execution, generator execution, or pytest rerun. Read/parse/hash operations only; wrote this review and, with parent authorization, corrected three mathematical statements in the reviewer-owned report.

source_level_cross3_key_findings_checked: oneof exactly-one wording conflicts with at-most-one implementation and empty test
spec/brief distinction exists; changing guidance visibility is prospective adaptation
code delivery and plan delivery are kept separate

findings.observation: The initial wording required normal integration and upstream revision costs separately even though one consumer call may perform both. Such a decomposition is not observable from aggregate time/tokens or changed paths.
findings.resolution: Parent added independently measurable qualification; subcosts are null for a combined call, complete measured call cost remains, no line-based apportionment or extra inference solely to obtain a decomposition.

findings.observation: Judgment explicitly received personal experience, while action initially listed only delivery and sealed judgment. A fresh API call does not retain the earlier model context merely because it is called the same recipient.
findings.resolution: Parent explicitly added the same sealed consumer experience snapshot to action input and stated that fresh calls must transmit it.

findings.observation: The original arrow to o_(t+1) could imply that B personal memory directly enters the next delivery even when A is selected next.
findings.resolution: Use the next time t+ that the same peer is selected, explicitly conditional on that time existing and the experience still being retained; the case states it is an analysis index, not future information given to the selector.

findings.observation: Equal choice distributions plus the same random number do not ensure equal sampled identities if candidate order or the sampling map differs.
findings.resolution: Require the same candidate ordering and sampling algorithm/random-number mapping as well as the same probabilities and random draw.

findings.observation: A universal numerical not-equal symbol was stronger than the supported statement that aggregate consumer cost does not identify marginal producer-caused repair cost. Coincidental equality is possible.
findings.resolution: Replaced the numerical inequality by a non-implication about identifiability; the original case and substantive conclusion remain.

remaining_design_assumptions: Ownership metadata names file responsibility but does not yet define every interface obligation or qualify its scorer; N03 keeps this open.
Independent parent scoring after final source sealing is offline measurement unless prospective visibility explicitly permits feedback; no diagnostic gold may silently enter experience.
Producer and consumer experience may both change future execution; all selector conditions must share the same experience mechanism while retaining their own histories.
CROSS3 plan-to-implementation adaptation may have no value beyond forwarding public requirements; the proposed direct requirement forwarding baseline is essential.
Private experience is a candidate source of persistent differences, not proof of specialization or a new realtime training method.

self_formula_case_audit.notes: Memory updates use only arrived authorized experience; third-party evidence retains judge and subject. The example of consumer A report returning to producer B is a prospective permission-dependent case, not a claim that N02 returned that feedback. Independent audit scores remain offline unless a future card explicitly authorizes disclosure.
